answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 51 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. The mesa register is checked at draw time, vault lists the eligible set, and vertex seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 51 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Each impostor pays 11 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
